post.description:
Evaluate feature decisions for the live dashboard team from each feature's published setting. No permission is granted by a decision. Features not offered to the team are omitted unless the team is enrolled; opt-in features include their terms before enrollment, and enrolled features stay visible for withdrawal.

Requires a verified dashboard bearer and current team authorization. Team keys and project tokens are not accepted.
post.x-exclusion-reason: Private dashboard feature discovery; requires live team membership.

post.description:
Live team owner/admin only. Enabling requires the feature's published opt-in setting, its current terms revision, entitlement, release eligibility and no operational disable; a terms change during the request returns 409. Withdrawal does not delete resources.

Requires a verified dashboard bearer and current team authorization. The signed-in member must be a team owner or admin. Team keys and project tokens are not accepted.
